summary.text: Kalan Haywood is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 16, where he took office in 2019, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Alciro Deacon.
He was first elected to public office in 2018 at age 19.

paragraphs.text: Kalan Haywood was first elected to public office in 2018 at age 19 and took his Assembly seat in 2019.
For 2025-2026 his committee assignments were Assembly Organization, Housing and Real Estate, Rules, Transportation, Legislative Organization, and the Joint Legislative Council.
